授業概要
このコースは、都市デザインの学生に持続可能で資源効率の高い都市に関する戦略と原則を包括的に理解することを目的としています。このコースでは、土地利用効率と省エネ建築の原則を紹介します。
土地利用効率は、都市デザインの重要な概念です。これは、都市が利用可能な土地資源をどの程度効果的に使って、住民のニーズや好みに応えているかを測るものです。土地利用効率は、密度、多様性、アクセシビリティ、接続性、居住性、持続可能性などのさまざまな指標で評価できます。これらの指標は、都市の機能性、品質、回復力の異なる側面を反映しています。土地利用効率が高いということは、都市が住民により多くの利益や機会を提供しながら、都市化の負の影響（渋滞、汚染、スプロール、不平等など）を最小限に抑えることができることを意味します。
This course aims to provide urban design students with a comprehensive understanding of the strategies and principles involved in sustainable and resource-efficient cities. This course will introduce principles of land use efficiency and energy-efficient buildings.
Urban land use efficiency is a key concept for urban design, as it measures how well a city uses its available land resources to meet the needs and preferences of its inhabitants. Urban land use efficiency can be assessed by various indicators, such as density, diversity, accessibility, connectivity, livability, and sustainability. These indicators reflect different aspects of urban functionality, quality, and resilience. A high level of urban land use efficiency indicates that a city can provide more benefits and opportunities for its residents while minimizing the negative impacts of urbanization, such as congestion, pollution, sprawl, and inequality. environments.

個別の教育目標
● Explain major theories of urbanization, spatial expansion, and urban shrinkage.
● Evaluate relationships between urban morphology, land-use diversity, transit, and microclimatic resilience.
● Analyze accessibility, land consumption, and built environment performance indicators.
● Critically assess planning strategies (e.g., Compact Cities, TOD, Rightsizing, Location Optimization Plans).
● Conduct independent, evidence-based research using scientific literature and case study methodologies.
授業計画
10/5: Introduction to Urbanization and Contemporary Urban Challenges
- Topics: Global urbanization trends, urban transition, demographic shifts, SDG 11.
10/19: Urban Expansion and Urban Sprawl
- Topics: Physical growth processes, peri-urbanization, sprawl characteristics, land consumption.
10/26: Land Use Change and Land Consumption
- Topics: Agricultural land conversion, land-take dynamics, environmental impacts of conversion.
- Exercise: Multi-temporal land use map interpretation exercise.
11/2: Urban Form and the Compact City Concept
- Topics: Urban morphology, urban density, compactness theory, Japanese compact city policy.
11/5: Land Use Diversity and Mixed-Use Development
- Topics: Land use mix, functional diversity, walkability, street vitality.
- Exercise: Neighborhood functional diversity analysis.
Block 2: Mobility, Accessibility & Environmental Performance
11/9: Accessibility and Spatial Interaction
- Topics: Accessibility theory, spatial interaction models, job-housing balance, service reach.
11/16: Transportation and Transit-Oriented Development (TOD)
- Topics: Land use-transport interaction, TOD principles, mass transit integration.
- Assignment Note: Assignment 1 Briefing & Guidance.
11/30: Climate Resilience & Urban Environmental Performance (New Topic)
- Topics: Urban Heat Island (UHI) mitigation, microclimates, urban flood resilience, ecosystem service integration in dense vs. dispersed built environments.
- Submission: Report Assignment due.

試験／成績評価の方法等
The course evaluation will be based on three components: attendance, participation, and final report.
1. Attendance will account for 30% of the grade, and students are expected to attend at least 80% of the classes.
2. Active participation in class discussions accounts for 10% of the grade.
3. The final report will account for 60% of the grade, and students are expected to submit a comprehensive and well-written report at the end of the course.
